description: Tool to update a Stripe charge object with provided parameters. Use when you need to modify charge details such as description, metadata, fraud assessment, receipt email, shipping information, or transfer group.

inputSchema.description: Request model for updating a Stripe charge.

charge_id.description: The ID of the charge to update.
charge_id.title: Charge Id

customer.description: The ID of an existing customer to associate with this charge. Only updatable if the charge has no existing customer.
customer.title: Customer

description.description: An arbitrary string to attach to the charge. Displayed in the Stripe Dashboard and on customer receipts.
description.title: Description

user_report.description: Either 'safe' or 'fraudulent'. Indicates your assessment of the charge's riskiness.
user_report.title: User Report

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs for storing structured information. Individual keys can be unset by posting empty values.
metadata.title: Metadata

receipt_email.description: The email address to send the receipt to. Updating this will trigger a new receipt email to be sent.
receipt_email.title: Receipt Email

city.description: City, district, suburb, town, or village.
city.title: City

line1.description: Address line 1 (e.g., street address, PO Box, or company name).
line1.title: Line1

line2.description: Address line 2 (e.g., apartment, suite, unit, or building).
line2.title: Line2

carrier.description: The delivery service that shipped a physical product (e.g., Fedex, UPS, USPS).
carrier.title: Carrier

tracking_number.description: The shipment tracking number. Use commas to separate multiple tracking numbers.
tracking_number.title: Tracking Number

transfer_group.description: A string that identifies this transaction as part of a group for connected accounts. Can only be set once.
transfer_group.title: Transfer Group

inputSchema.title: UpdateChargeRequest

name: update_charge

city.description: City, district, suburb, town, or village.
city.title: City

line1.description: Address line 1 (e.g., street, PO Box, or company name).
line1.title: Line1

line2.description: Address line 2 (e.g., apartment, suite, unit, or building).
line2.title: Line2

BillingDetails.description: Billing information associated with the payment method.
BillingDetails.title: BillingDetails

FraudDetails.description: Information on fraud assessments for the charge.

stripe_report.description: Assessments from Stripe. If set, the value is fraudulent.
stripe_report.title: Stripe Report

user_report.description: Assessments reported by you. If set, possible values are safe and fraudulent.
user_report.title: User Report

FraudDetails.title: FraudDetails

Outcome.description: Details about whether the payment was accepted, and why.

network_status.description: Possible values are approved_by_network, declined_by_network, not_sent_to_network, and reversed_after_approval.
network_status.title: Network Status

reason.description: An enumerated value providing a more detailed explanation of the outcome's type.
reason.title: Reason

risk_level.description: Stripe Radar's evaluation of the riskiness of the payment. Possible values for evaluated payments are normal, elevated, highest.
risk_level.title: Risk Level

risk_score.description: Stripe Radar's evaluation of the riskiness of the payment. Possible values are between 0 and 100.
risk_score.title: Risk Score

rule.description: The ID of the Radar rule that matched the payment, if applicable.
rule.title: Rule

seller_message.description: A human-readable description of the outcome type and reason, designed for you (the recipient of the payment), not your customer.
seller_message.title: Seller Message

type.description: Possible values are authorized, manual_review, issuer_declined, blocked, and invalid.
type.title: Type

Outcome.title: Outcome

PaymentMethodDetails.description: Details about the payment method at the time of the transaction.

type.description: The type of transaction-specific details of the payment method used in the payment.
type.title: Type

us_bank_account.description: Details for US bank account payments.
us_bank_account.title: Us Bank Account

PaymentMethodDetails.title: PaymentMethodDetails

amount.description: Amount, in cents (or other smallest currency unit).
amount.title: Amount

balance_transaction.description: Balance transaction that describes the impact on your account balance.
balance_transaction.title: Balance Transaction

charge.description: ID of the charge that was refunded.
charge.title: Charge

created.description: Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
created.title: Created

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code, in lowercase.
currency.title: Currency

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object.
metadata.title: Metadata

object.description: String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value.
object.title: Object

reason.description: Reason for the refund, either user-provided or generated automatically.
reason.title: Reason

receipt_number.description: This is the transaction number that appears on email receipts sent for this refund.
receipt_number.title: Receipt Number

RefundsList.description: A list of refunds that have been applied to the charge.

has_more.description: Whether or not there are more elements available after this set.
has_more.title: Has More

object.description: String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value. Always has the value list.

url.description: The URL for accessing this list.

RefundsList.title: RefundsList

carrier.description: The delivery service that shipped a physical product, such as Fedex, UPS, USPS, etc.

tracking_number.description: The tracking number for a physical product, obtained from the delivery service.

amount.description: The amount transferred to the destination account, if specified.

destination.description: ID of an existing, connected Stripe account to transfer funds to if transfer_data was specified in the charge request.
destination.title: Destination

UpdateChargeResponse.description: Response model containing the updated charge object.

transfer_group.description: A string that identifies this transaction as part of a group.
transfer_group.title: Transfer Group

billing_details.description: Billing information associated with the payment method at the time of the transaction.
billing_details.title: Billing Details

disputed.description: Whether the charge has been disputed.
disputed.title: Disputed

refunds.description: A list of refunds that have been applied to the charge.
refunds.title: Refunds

failure_code.description: Error code explaining reason for charge failure if available.
failure_code.title: Failure Code

application.description: ID of the Connect application that created the charge.
application.title: Application

failure_balance_transaction.description: ID of the balance transaction that describes the reversal of the balance on your account due to payment failure.
failure_balance_transaction.title: Failure Balance Transaction

refunded.description: Whether the charge has been fully refunded. If the charge is only partially refunded, this attribute will still be false.
refunded.title: Refunded

description.description: An arbitrary string attached to the object. Often useful for displaying to users.
description.title: Description

paid.description: true if the charge succeeded, or was successfully authorized for later capture.
paid.title: Paid

failure_message.description: Message to user further explaining reason for charge failure if available.
failure_message.title: Failure Message

amount_refunded.description: Amount in cents (or other smallest currency unit) refunded (can be less than the amount attribute on the charge if a partial refund was issued).
amount_refunded.title: Amount Refunded

created.description: Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
created.title: Created

status.description: The status of the payment is either succeeded, pending, or failed.
status.title: Status

payment_method_details.description: Details about the payment method at the time of the transaction.
payment_method_details.title: Payment Method Details

customer.description: ID of the customer this charge is for if one exists.
customer.title: Customer

application_fee.description: The application fee (if any) for the charge.
application_fee.title: Application Fee

review.description: ID of the review associated with this charge if one exists.
review.title: Review

calculated_statement_descriptor.description: The full statement descriptor that is passed to card networks, and that is displayed on your customer's credit card statement.
calculated_statement_descriptor.title: Calculated Statement Descriptor

payment_intent.description: ID of the PaymentIntent associated with this charge, if one exists.
payment_intent.title: Payment Intent

application_fee_amount.description: The amount of the application fee (if any) requested for the charge.
application_fee_amount.title: Application Fee Amount

on_behalf_of.description: The account (if any) the charge was made on behalf of without triggering an automatic transfer.
on_behalf_of.title: On Behalf Of

receipt_url.description: This is the URL to view the receipt for this charge. The receipt is kept up-to-date to the latest state of the charge.
receipt_url.title: Receipt Url

receipt_number.description: This is the transaction number that appears on email receipts sent for this charge.
receipt_number.title: Receipt Number

balance_transaction.description: ID of the balance transaction that describes the impact of this charge on your account balance (not including refunds or disputes).
balance_transaction.title: Balance Transaction

transfer_data.description: An optional dictionary including the account to automatically transfer to as part of a destination charge.
transfer_data.title: Transfer Data

amount_captured.description: Amount in cents (or other smallest currency unit) captured (can be less than the amount attribute on the charge if a partial capture was made).
amount_captured.title: Amount Captured

receipt_email.description: This is the email address that the receipt for this charge was sent to.
receipt_email.title: Receipt Email

statement_descriptor_suffix.description: Provides information about the charge that customers see on their statements.
statement_descriptor_suffix.title: Statement Descriptor Suffix

statement_descriptor.description: For card charges, use statement_descriptor_suffix instead. Otherwise, you can use this value as the complete description of a charge on your customer's credit card statement.
statement_descriptor.title: Statement Descriptor

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format.
metadata.title: Metadata

livemode.description: Has the value true if the object exists in live mode or the value false if the object exists in test mode.
livemode.title: Livemode

fraud_details.description: Information on fraud assessments for the charge.
fraud_details.title: Fraud Details

amount.description: Amount intended to be collected by this payment. A positive integer representing how much to charge in the smallest currency unit.
amount.title: Amount

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code, in lowercase. Must be a supported currency.
currency.title: Currency

payment_method.description: ID of the payment method used in this charge.
payment_method.title: Payment Method

object.description: String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value.
object.title: Object

captured.description: If the charge was created without capturing, this Boolean represents whether it is still uncaptured or has since been captured.
captured.title: Captured

outcome.description: Details about whether the payment was accepted, and why.
outcome.title: Outcome

source_transfer.description: The transfer ID which created this charge. Only present if the charge came from another Stripe account.
source_transfer.title: Source Transfer
